verdict.rationale: Braintrust's evals framework lets engineers define custom scorers (LLM-as-judge or code-based) attached to Eval() runs, playgrounds support iterating on scorers/prompts/models, and online scoring applies scorers automatically to production traces. Docs and SDK examples (Eval, scores array, Evaluator wrapper) confirm configurable scorer support across code, UI, and CI/CD. Missing for 10: no explicit independent/hands-on validation of LLM-judge scorer accuracy or configuration depth beyond docs.
